card.name: Cavaleira Sereia
card.summary: Enquanto Umi estiver com a face para cima, pode atacar duas vezes em cada Fase de Batalha.

textEvidence.text: This monster has one continuous effect, active only while a face-up card whose rules name is Umi is present on either field: it may declare at most two attacks per Battle Phase, including direct attacks. This permission is not an extra pair of attacks and does not stack with another two-attack permission. Removing Umi, hiding this monster or negating its effects removes the permission immediately. A face-down Umi is insufficient. The identity requirement is distinct from negating Umi effects. There is no activation cost, target, player selection or secondary effect.
